name: download-in-background
description: Decky Loader plugin for background downloading with screen off and power savings on SteamOS.

scripts.package: shx rm -rf build DownloadInBackground.zip && shx mkdir -p build/DownloadInBackground && shx cp -r dist plugin.json main.py package.json assets build/DownloadInBackground/ && cd build && zip -r ../DownloadInBackground.zip DownloadInBackground && cd ..
